name: Jaguero Isle
summary: On Jaguero Isle, King Mukla rules the wild beasts. Fierce panthers and gorillas haunt its jungle off Stranglethorn Vale’s eastern coast.

sections.title: A Primal Domain
sections.body:
Jaguero Isle lies off Stranglethorn Vale’s southeastern coast, far from the mainland pirate camps and troll ruins. Untamed panthers and aggressive gorillas roam the island. King Mukla, a gigantic ape, rules the rocky interior and guards it fiercely.

Few sailors willingly approach the reefs. Bottles found along the mainland beaches sometimes carry desperate pleas for rescue from people stranded ashore.

sections.title: The Captive Princess
sections.body: Princess Poobah, a shipwrecked tauren, is held captive by King Mukla on Jaguero Isle. Stranded among the island’s predators, she sends distress notes in bottles across the Wild Shore’s tides. She hopes someone will brave Mukla’s wrath and help her escape.

faq.answer: Jaguero Isle lies in the Great Sea, off Stranglethorn Vale’s southeastern coast, just east of the Wild Shore.
King Mukla is a gigantic, powerful gorilla who rules Jaguero Isle’s interior. He is territorial and aggressive.
Princess Poobah is a tauren stranded on Jaguero Isle, far from her home. She sends messages in bottles into the sea, hoping for rescue.

faq.q: How do you start the quest to visit the island?
faq.answer: You can find half-buried bottles washed ashore along the Wild Shore’s mainland beaches. Inside, a folded note asks for aid.

angles.text: As a tauren, you may feel a personal duty to free Princess Poobah, a fellow tauren trapped far from Kalimdor among hostile beasts.
As a hunter, you can test your tracking skills against Jaguero Isle’s exotic predators, from stalking panthers to the mighty King Mukla.
